reviews.text: My puppy Daichi is doing so well after day school! I am continuing with 1:1 and maybe boarding school! Love yall

Siara, Ashlee, John, and the whole OPBarks team are absolutely incredible!!!

Joy, my Bernedoodle puppy, has made so much progress over the past couple of months. She is calmer, happier, more emotionally regulated, and so much better at handling everyday situations. We have worked on greetings, heel, loose leash walking, place, off-leash recall, “get it,” “drop it,” impulse control, manners, and helping her settle as a relaxed, fulfilled dog.

The biggest difference is not just that Joy knows more commands. It is that she is becoming a better version of herself. She is learning how to calm down, make better choices, and enjoy life as a more confident and well-balanced dog.
The OPBarks team is patient, knowledgeable, kind, and extremely effective. They clearly understand dogs, but they also do a great job teaching owners how to communicate better with their dogs.

I am so thankful for everything they have done for Joy.
Highly, highly recommend OPBarks to anyone who wants excellent dog training and a happier, better-mannered dog!

We have had a few drop off services as well as 1:1 meetings with our 3yo lab/hound mix. The difference is noticeable at his attentiveness and training during walks and around the house. Most of the training we had done with him had been at-home, but when adding a professional trainer to the mix he has made impressive strides. I look forward to our follow up trainings!

Janet and the team at Opportunity Barks are fantastic. I brought my 11 week old puppy for the Puppy Foundations class and found the classes and support to be outstanding. Janet specifically worked to understand our dynamic and how to implement training for each dog's specific temperament and level. I felt so supported and my (many) questions were always answered thoughtfully and with so much care. For puppy training, the people need feedback just as much as the dogs and Janet was instrumental in helping me to understand what's working and what's not and how I can improve and learn. If there was a Foundations 2.0 class for pups, I would sign up in a heartbeat.

If I could give more than 5 stars I would! My beautiful Teddy Roosevelt and I are about to celebrate our 1 year anniversary with Opportunity Barks and Farm Dog. It's the best decision we ever made! And yes 'we'. While it's benefit is certainly for my Teddy, I feel equally grateful for the team and people that work at Opportunity Barks. Especially our 'Aunt Chelsea' :) It's like a family there and they treat your baby as if they were their own. Grateful for all of you! And if that picture isn't pure joy, I don't know what is.

We had a great experience with Opportunity Barks. We did the private lessons for our very stubborn but smart Malinois/Pittie mix and the amount she learned was wonderful. I was unable to walk her on a leash without some major pulling. Through training and helping to find the right leash combo for her we are doing so much better! They were patient and understanding with both myself and my pup, answered every question and were so flexible with us. I cant wait to be able to send her to the farm school cause I think our pup will love it!
Highly recommend!

OPBarks has been a blessing to find! It’s the perfect place for our city dog Wallace to get outside and romp around for the day. He always comes home exhausted and happy. We feel so safe and confident leaving Wallace with the team at OPbarks. Chelsea and Laura in particular have been incredible and Wallace perks up just hearing their names. They’re incredibly skilled and knowledgeable with all things training and watching after dogs

As a first-time dog owner, I came into training a bit nervous. At the Old City location, Ashley made a real impact during classes and day school. Her guidance helped me build a strong, trust-based bond with my dog and made the whole process feel approachable and supportive. I learned so much more than I expected.

Because of that experience, we became curious about OPBarks Farm Dog and attended an on-site event to check it out. I can confidently say we wouldn’t have explored Farm Dog as quickly if it weren’t for the people we met. It was clear the team not only loves what they do, but are knowledgeable, resourceful, and deeply invested in the dogs they work with. They create a safe, enriching environment for dogs to grow.

After meeting Chelsea, Rachael, Bre, and Laura, we felt confident starting Farm Dog training. It’s been incredibly rewarding, and we love working with Chelsea! Our dog comes home with a little pep in her step, and that happiness carries over well after she’s back home. It’s been a great experience, and I’d definitely recommend taking full advantage of everything OPBarks offers, it’s worth it!
Our two dogs go regularly to Farm Dog. They LOVE the exercise, socialization and training. Farm Dig is the BEST!

I can’t say enough good things about Opportunity Barks. Smokey looks forward to his weekly farm dog day. He comes home so happy and exhausted and the report card and pictures make me so happy to see how much fun he is having with his friends. The staff are amazing and treat every dog like their own. Chelsea is the best and each time I drop Smokey off he is so happy to see her and the van he forgets all about me.

Our dog Finnegan has been attending the farm dog program for the past four years and it is the highlight of his week. He absolutely loves going and is exhausted when he comes home. We couldn’t say enough positive things about the whole team, especially Chelsea. She has gone above and beyond for Finnegan and we are forever grateful we found Opportunity barks!
So thankful for opportunity barks (especially to Chelsea) for always taking such good care of our pup at their farm dog program. Our guy always comes home exhausted and happy.

Opportunity Barks is truly one of a kind—an incredible space that goes above and beyond in every way. It’s hands-down unmatched in Philly and we are so grateful to be a part of the Farm Dog community.

A big , big thank you to Chelsea for all of the care, attention, and genuine love shown to our pup, Gus. Every time we tell him it is a Farm Dog day he is over the moon with excitement - and then comes home happy and tired.  (With an amazing collection of Adventure Album photos and videos to capture the day ❤️🐶.)

We would recommend Opportunity Barks to anyone and everyone.

We love the OpBarks crew! we have truly done it all with this group, starting with puppy classes and now progressing to Farm Dog which our city Portie loves. she comes back exhausted after a day of outdoor stimulation with the best trainers around. Chelsea is her favorite and she can’t wait to jump in the van in the morning! Boarding with them is also great since as she is part of the training culture and it’s great reinforcement when the humans are away - we always say she’s going on vacation just when we are because she loves it and the whole crew so much. thanks for all you do helping our city pups navigate too much stimulation and helping us understand them better - we love our OpBarks fam!

The OpBarks team takes outstanding care of our dog. They take the time to understand your dog's behavior and provide a comprehensive plan for training and care. Shout-out to Chelsea and the farm dog crew who have gone over the top with making sure he is comfortable every day he is out on the farm.

Finding OpBarks truly changed our lives. When I rescued Bumi, he was timid, insecure, and completely overwhelmed by the world. Scared of everything the city had to offer. I honestly felt in over my head. I had never had a dog with this level of anxiety before, and I didn’t know how to help him feel safe.

From the very beginning, the OpBarks team showed us so much patience, compassion, and understanding. They didn’t just train Bumi but they supported me too. Together, we built confidence day by day, starting with group classes and eventually moving into day school. With their guidance, we achieved things that once felt impossible and far out of reach.

Today, Bumi is a completely different dog. He’s braver, more confident, and continues to grow every single day. Watching him trust the world again has been one of the most rewarding experiences. And honestly if it were up to Bumi, he would go to day school every single day.

I am endlessly grateful for the OpBarks team and the care they put into what they do. Finding them changed our lives, and I couldn’t recommend them more!

Special shout out to Ashlee, Janet and Siara! We will miss seeing you every week.

After years of being on the fence about seeking out professional help, I finally did it, and I’m so mad I didn’t do it sooner. Ashlee and the team at OpBarks are incredible! They gave me the tools to be able to manage two high energy dogs, without depriving them of the joys of life. I now have two significantly more obedient dogs that are more confident walking around the streets of Philadelphia, which is a big deal for us. I know I still have work to do on my end, but I truly could not thank them enough for providing us all with the training we needed.

Janet and the team at Opp Barks is fantastic. They do an amazing job of teaching real communication between you and your pup. They are extremely attentive and detailed. We saw a massive improvement between the beggining and end of class. Would highly reccomend for anyone looking for dog training basics and improved puppy communication

Our new puppy Bowie was VERY scared and timid going into her first puppy social and started off by hiding behind the furniture. Janet appropriately helped manage the pack and worked to put Bowie in a comfortable space (along with the other timid pups). Over the next several weeks, Janet helped Bowie blossom: by the third week, she was a full-on crazy (in a good way) participant and is wholly comfortable (and playing) with all dogs, everywhere. Would highly recommend OpBarks and Janet specifically!

Hi hi HI! I’m Archie (Certified Zoomies Expert, Border Collie mix, Age 10 Months) and I have MANY IMPORTANT THINGS TO SAY about my favorite place: Opportunity Barks!

First, I am what humans call “energetic” and “too smart for my own good” and “please stop squeaking that ball for five seconds.” So my humans took me to Puppy Fundamentals when I was tiny and chaotic. It was AWESOME. There were treats and toys and another puppy to practice being a puppy with! Then we did Agility and ohWOWTHEREWEREJUMPS. I didn’t know I could bounce that high but now I do and now my humans know too and they look slightly concerned, but they were really proud of me and I can tell they had fun too. Right now I’m in a class called Leash & Leave It which I think means “please stop pulling this human’s arm out and trying to eat mystery trash.” I get to practice walking like a gentleman while secretly plotting to grab every leaf in existence.

But the BEST part is my new friend Janet, a magical human trainer who understands my wiggles AND my stress eyebrows. Janet gives me lots of individual attention and somehow know when I’m excited vs. when I’m pretending to listen but actually thinking about what toy I want to destroy. Janet tells my humans what to look for so they finally understand that I bark with love, not chaos (okay sometimes chaos). Janet doesn’t make us all do the same things either because I’m a smart, mischievous boy with Opinions and Zoom Modes, so we get instructions that match our ages and brains and breeds. Janet is super clear and patient and give my humans homework (I call it snack practice), and recommends cool stuff like better collars and activities and toys for my humans to keep researching instead of panicking. Janet knew I was going to love my lure toy so much, and now it’s what my humans call “the only way we will get any peace around here”.  Also, Janet gives me so many treats I think we’re officially best friends. I take them ever so gently (except the occasional, accidental chomp of love—sorry Janet!!).

About Opportunity Barks itself:
•	It’s like a neighborhood clubhouse but for dogs AND the people who carry the treat bags.
•	There are classes for everything—not just “my dog chewed the couch” stuff, but fun enrichment things so we can learn and play and hang out together.
•	My humans said booking was easy and the website had lots of good info, but I don’t do keyboards so I’ll take their word.
•	The graduation ceremonies are SO CUTE. I wore a little bandana, I picked a toy and everyone clapped and I got so happy I wiggled my whole soul.
•	My humans say it’s a “good value” which I think means “worth every treat pouch.”
•	We’ve met lots of dog people there who smile at me instead of saying “oh no.” It feels like a little dog-loving community and I like that because I am very social and also nosy.

Anyway I gotta go yell at a smaller dog outside, but if you’re a dog or a human with a dog, you should go to Opportunity Barks and ask for Janet. Tell them Archie sent you and that I can’t wait to see them next time!

Wags and wiggles,
Archie

We have a 7 month old lab who has drive (high energy and has impulsive moments). We started our training journey at another puppy kindergarten but it wasn't a good fit and wasn't really addressing our puppy's learning needs. We frequently felt like we had the bad dog in class. We were frustrated and wanted to help our dog become the best version of himself. Dogs are like people- they are all different and have varying personalities and learning/training requirements. They might not be easy to train.We read the description for the Knucklehead Foundations class and knew our guy was their poster child.

I almost cried at our first private lesson with Leigh. Someone finally really looked at our dog and could identify his needs and help us.

Between the Knucklehead classes with Janet and our private lessons we knew we made the correct decision to go to Opportunity Barks. They observed our pup and gave us tailored, real life skills to start working on our handling and finding his off switch. We finally feel like we found trainers that can help us achieve our goal. We are so grateful!

Honora & Saint

We've been taking our dog to Opportunity Barks 'Farm Dog' program for almost two years and she loves it!  We were referred to Opportunity Barks for training.  Their approach was very gentle but effective.   We learned that Bailey actually was insecure and lacked confidence; likely from her unstable home arrangements in the past.  She had been dropped at a shelter as a puppy and then was placed with a couple during covid; only to be abandon at a boarding facility less than a year later when the couple broke up.  Opportunity Barks were able to diagnos the issue and then help us to build her confidence while at the same time gain her trust.  She has become such a calm and happy pup; and we owe that in large part to the team at Opportunity Barks.

Before Opportunity Barks, walks with my dog were stressful and frustrating — constant pulling, barking at other dogs, and major anxiety around trucks and other loud noises. We’d tried other programs, but nothing stuck. I was feeling helpless and hopeless.

From day one in the City Dog program, Ashlee and the team created a plan that worked. I quickly saw changes and finally felt like I could communicate with my dog. She was excited to go to school, and I started enjoying our walks again.

She’s not perfect yet, but now I have the tools and confidence to help her keep improving — and our bond is stronger than ever. Highly recommend!

**Update**
Thanks again for the kindness. I was talking to my vet and we agreed that my pup probably needs more support. Like from a Behavior Clinic. Opportunity Barks was not a good fit for my pup. But it can be a good fit for other pups.

*Old review*
The staff were kind. But this was a huge waste of money. My dog did the day school program for the longest amount of time possible. My main concerns were his anxiety and reactivity around strangers. This program did not help whatsoever. At the end the trainer told me "some dogs just don't like strangers." So my dog graduated the program. He still struggles with anxiety and reactivity. There wasn't any notable change in his behavior.

Had some doubts about how quickly or if I even would see results and I was thrilled with the outcome. My girl was developing some bad habits that I did not know how to address properly. In a very short amount of time the team here gave me the lessons I needed to not only correct those habits but help me help her turn into an even better dog. Highly recommend.

My dog Kelce has received training at the center city facility and the Farm dog program in Sellersville. You can tell right away that the trainers love the dogs. I feel great about leaving  Kelce in their care for the day and she loves going and seeing her human and dog friends! She comes home happy and exhausted. I highly recommend Opportunity Barks.

We had a scary incident with our Corgi who had attacked another dog at daycare. We knew it was time to bring in professional help for the issues we could not address at home. I was connected with Monica and within 2 days we had set up a last minute board and train for our Ollie for the beginning of the following week. The turn around time was seamless. All of my questions and concerns addressed. And rest assured, Monica empathized all the feelings surrounding our Ollie and that our feelings were valid. We weren’t the only dog parents feeling this way and wanting what was best! We are so excited and eager to see the progress with our boy and can’t wait to see him 2 weeks from now!

Choosing Op Barks was hands down the best decision I’ve ever made. I had tried training my dog on my own and none of the youtube videos or tik toks were working. So my dog went to Op Barks farm dog training, and it changed our lives. They helped me understand the importance of structure in her life, and I saw improvement within the first three days.

About six months later, my dog and I are doing things I never thought possible—going on off-leash hikes, playing, taking structured walks, and even doing agility courses. Our connection/bond has only gotten stronger. OP helped us get there.

All of the trainers are truly committed to understanding my dog and helping her learn. It’s hard to find people who will love your dog the way you do, but I think OP trainers come very close. They put so much thought and care into their training plans, making sure everything works for your lifestyle and your dog. It’s a little dramatic, but I have cried quite a few tears over all of the progress we’ve made.

I still send my dog to the enrichment program at the farm, and it’s something we both look forward to.

I could not recommend them more. In fact, I recommend them to everyone I meet.

We have loved working with OP Barks for training with our pup. We rescued our dog as a puppy and they set up phone calls and got to understand our training needs right away. They are great everyday life trainers and have so many programs to choose from including puppy training boarding options, off leash training with farm dog, and boarding! We hope to continue to take advantage of their many services and have had great results with the trainings they’ve done so far. Can’t wait to continue working with them and their amazing team.

We have had an awesome experience with Opportunity Barks! Our red fox lab Otis went there when he was just a few months old for a week long boarding and puppy training. I think he fell in love with being there and we were happy to have back a super gentle dog who learned all the basics and now, we just had a follow up call with Leigh to get a quick and dirty download of what to do for some habitual barking and begging. I love Leigh's matter of fact attitude and super friendly and helpful approach. We will def be back for more training this spring!

We’ve had nothing but great experiences with OPB and can’t recommend them enough. Our golden, Copper, started out with puppy classes, has moved onto some private sessions with Oli, and is making incredible progress! The whole team is so kind and you can tell they all are so passionate about what they do. We’re so happy to have found this community and look forward to more fun and learning for our little guy!
